sections.title: Market Pulse: Hawkish Fed Concerns Weigh on Close

items.headline: Stocks Dip Friday as Fed Chair Warsh Signals Potential Rate Hikes, Weekly Gains Hold
items.summary: U.S. equities closed lower on Friday, August 29, 2026, as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium reignited concerns over potential September interest rate hikes. Despite the daily pullback, major indices managed to secure weekly gains. Market breadth was negative, indicating a cautious sentiment among investors, with significant outflows from equity funds. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Nvidia Shares Decline on Profit-Taking and AI Partnership News
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell 4.6% after Thursday's post-earnings surge, driven by profit-taking, hawkish Fed comments, and reports of a halt in parts of its AI compute financing partnership.

items.headline: PayPal Plunges on Abandoned Acquisition Talks
items.summary: PayPal saw a significant 12.7% drop following a report that a consortium had abandoned its pursuit of the payments company.

items.headline: Marvell Technology Tumbles Amid AI Revenue Concerns
items.summary: Marvell Technology fell 10.3% due to concerns surrounding the timing of revenue from its artificial intelligence chip agreement with Google.

items.headline: Gap Surges on Unspecified Positive News
items.summary: Gap shares surged nearly 13% during Friday's session, though specific drivers were not detailed in available reports.

items.headline: Apple Continues Upward Momentum
items.summary: Apple gained 1.6%, contributing to the offset of broader market declines.

items.headline: Alphabet Rises, Boosting Megacap Performance
items.summary: Alphabet rose 1.7%, adding to the positive performance of several megacap stocks.

items.headline: Fed Chair Warsh's Hawkish Jackson Hole Speech Resets Rate Expectations
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's address at the Jackson Hole symposium on Friday provided a clearer warning on inflation than anticipated, leading traders to increase bets on a 25-basis-point rate hike at the September FOMC meeting. Warsh emphasized the Fed's commitment to its 2% inflation target and noted that financial markets may be underpricing inflation risks.

items.headline: Communication Services and Technology Lead Weekly Gains; Semiconductors and Small Caps Lag
items.summary: For the week ending August 29, 2026, Communication Services (+1.43%) and Technology (+1.30%) led sector performance. However, Friday saw a pullback in the semiconductor sector, with the VanEck Semiconductor ETF falling over 3% for the week. Small-cap and micro-cap stocks also sold off, with the Russell 2000 down 1.5% weekly, indicating a narrow market advance.

items.headline: July PCE Inflation Exceeds Expectations; Q2 GDP Unchanged
items.summary: July's Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data showed a 0.2% monthly increase and a 3.7% annual rise, surpassing the 3.6% expectation. Core PCE matched expectations. The second estimate for Q2 GDP remained unchanged at a 1.5% annual rate.

items.headline: Concerns Mount Over AI Bubble Amid Historic S&P 500 Concentration
items.summary: Fund managers are increasingly citing an 'AI bubble' as a significant market risk, with the S&P 500's top 10 companies, heavily invested in AI, accounting for approximately 40% of the index – a concentration not seen since 1965.
